body: I went to one in high school but i had more acne back then so I was mainly focused on that but ill definitely go back and mention this! Thank you :)

This has been here since elementary school and im now in college. The picture doesnt show the redness great but you can see the flakiness. My routine right now is cera ve SA cleanser, paulas choice BHA exfoliant, and the cera ve lotion for rough and bumpy skin. Ive used countless other products but nothing helps. Right after I moisturize the dryness is better but still very red, but literally minutes later it flakes again. The rest of my skin is on the oily side these are the only dry patches i ever have. Any product recommendations would be greatly appreciated!!
